parsed.why: No criminalisation or documented trans targeting, but no marker-change remedy, no protection naming gender identity, thin data. Latent stigmatisation plus open border-document questions hold it a step below acceptance-with-protections.
Sodomy law plus official hostility, refused LGBT registration, no recourse, closeted existence. Statute is secondary but surrounds a hostile, unprotected environment; documented harms dated to 2015.

No criminalisation, but documented transfemicide pattern, birth-sex jail placement with head-shaving, police arresting Pride participants, local cross-dressing bans. Patchy local protections and a mayoral apology partially offset.

No criminalisation and thin documented hostility, but no gender-marker route at all (eight rejections, no plans), documented frontier document confusion, and exclusion of same-sex partners from protections.

Strong working protections and court relief, but airport screening demands surgery, 2025 state data shows record anti-LGBTQ violence with organised app ambushes, and custody-isolation practice documented.
